current_bridge_candidates.claim: For a suitable NP-complete binding, k(x) <= c * log n and the admitted O(k*3^k) route applies with polynomial reduction and preprocessing.
A proof-preserving quotient/cache representation has polynomially many states and polynomial total transition/discovery work for every input in the bound NP-complete domain.

tranception_overlay.operator: BACK -> FORWARD -> LEFT -> RIGHT -> FORWARD -> BACK
tranception_overlay.BACK: Recover the minimum missing theorem from the current open receipt.
tranception_overlay.FORWARD: Replay exactly one frozen bridge candidate without moving the success criteria.
tranception_overlay.LEFT: Use the admitted A3 scoped compression theorem as constructive homolog.
tranception_overlay.RIGHT: Use C023 and adversarial families as obstruction-side homolog without asymptotic promotion.
tranception_overlay.FORWARD_AGAIN: Require every general-polynomial gate to pass.
tranception_overlay.BACK_AGAIN: Attack the surviving claim and return to the earliest failed checkpoint.
